title: A pawn can take a queen
hint: Pawns capture one square diagonally. Move e4 to d5.

title: Take the queen with your rook
hint: Rooks move straight. Move d2 to d5 and take the queen.

title: Take the rook on the diagonal
hint: Bishops move diagonally. Move d2 to f4 and take the rook.

title: A knight fork? Just take the queen!
hint: Knights move in an L: two squares, then one. Move f3 to e5.
